items.title: nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
items.excerpt: Turn any LLM into a Jev-style decision model: typed decisions, real probabilities, no training. (continue updating, welcome any issue and PR request)
items.summary: Nokia Applied Research describes AnyJev as converting any LLM into a Jev-style decision model with typed decisions and real probabilities without training.
items.usefulness: Could help structure probabilistic outputs from language models if building a tool that requires calibrated confidence estimates alongside decisions.
items.to_verify: Whether 'real probabilities' means properly calibrated confidence scores or merely normalized model logits; whether actual LLM fine-tuning is truly unnecessary.
